issues: This document is an accreditation scope for an INSPECTION BODY ("Область аккредитации органа инспекции"), not a testing-laboratory scope: the table has no показатель/диапазон/единица columns at all (columns are № п/п, Наименование объекта, Код ОК(ОКПД2), Код ТН ВЭД ТС, Вид или тип инспекции и документы..., Документы, устанавливающие методы инспекции...). Per schema, indicator/range_from/range_to/unit are null for every row since no such data exists in the source. norm_doc combines both the 'вид/тип инспекции и требования' column and the 'методы инспекции' column, joined with '; '. No ТР ТС / раздел section-heading rows exist anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null throughout (per instructions, not substituted with addresses or other headings). Some ТН ВЭД ТС codes appear as unusually long digit strings (e.g. '1101-1106100000', '06042020000', '0603110000') exactly as printed in the source cells on pages 3-4; these look like possible OCR/source merging artifacts from a cramped multi-line cell but are transcribed as-is per the no-invention rule. Only 2 numbered object rows exist in the whole 4-page document; row 1 spans pages 1-3 and row 2 spans pages 3-4, merged into single logical rows per the page-break rule. No rotated or illegible pages.
